stage0023_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that's the lightweight-spec $$スコープドッグ$$.」

stage0023_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Whoa, that's a lot of skin showing...!
　It'd be perfect if it were a girl, not an AT!」

stage0023_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ルカ$$
「I tip my hat to that way of thinking...」

stage0023_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$クラン$$
「But since it sacrificed armor for that,
　even a minor hit could be fatal.」

stage0023_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マオ$$
「A do-or-die machine...
　Guess that's just like $$キリコ$$, though.」

stage0023_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Come on, $$キリコ$$!
　The odds are seven to three against us!」

stage0023_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Bottom line, if you win, we make a killing!
　We're counting on you, $$キリコ$$!」

stage0023_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「It's pointless, you two.
　The win's already decided for Balarant.」

stage0023_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「When $$カン・ユー$$ brought me this deal,
　I was sure of the win.
　If anything, I worried it wouldn't even be a match.」

stage0023_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「But thanks to your $$レッドショルダー$$ Team
　hyping it up so loud, the odds
　settled to something worth a laugh.」

stage0023_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「You two really are my goddess of luck.」

stage0023_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Much obliged for that.
　Looks like this is turning into a real
　big battle for both of us.」

stage0023_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units.
　Valkyries can't use their mobility at low
　altitude, so fight in Battroid mode.」

stage0023_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$キリコ$$, the enemy's after you.
　I know $$フィアナ$$'s on your mind, but
　don't forget, if you go down, it's all for nothing.」

stage0023_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Cover me.
　When the time comes, use that.」

stage0023_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...You're really not cut out for combat.」

stage0023_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$キリコ$$
「But if you fight past that,
　I've got nothing more to say.」

stage0023_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Heard about it, but damn, it's huge.
　This one's gonna be a pain.」

stage0023_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$宗介$$
「A bigger enemy calls for a bigger approach.」

stage0023_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$マオ$$
「You're fired up, Sousuke.
　Catch some of $$キリコ$$'s heat?」

stage0023_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　I'll give you credit for not running!」

stage0023_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Relax, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　Your woman's aboard this ship!」

stage0023_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「My nervous system is wired into the $$地上戦艦$$.
　This ship is like my own limbs, so to speak.」

stage0023_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Despair, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　I'll teach you the terror of crushing power!」

stage0023_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$宗介$$
「Understood.
　We'll stop that battleship in its tracks.」

stage0023_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Leave the support to us, the Snoopers.」

stage0023_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$キリコ$$, $n!
　The rest is on you, go in and rescue $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0023_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
Spectator
「Man, I can't get enough of this!」

stage0023_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
Spectator
「This thrill!
　Coming to $$ア・コバ$$ was the right call!」

stage0023_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「You two!
　Are you ready for this?」

stage0023_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I'll kill you, $$レッドショルダー$$!」

stage0023_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Now! The big battle begins!!」

stage0023_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Tch!
　This handles nothing like an AT!」

stage0023_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll leave my AT to you here.」

stage0023_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$n
「Be careful.
　No telling what a wounded beast will do.」

stage0023_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$n
「Contact me if something happens.
　I can at least offer backup.」

stage0023_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Stay sharp, everyone!
　That battleship's still alive!」

stage0023_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$バニラ$$
（Make sure you save $$フィアナ$$!）

stage0023_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
Spectator
「Hey, what's going on!
　That $$地上戦艦$$ isn't moving at all!」

stage0023_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
Spectator
「Looks like $$レッドショルダー$$
　went inside it, but...」

stage0023_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Anyone not into this match is an amateur!
　I'll refund you, so just go home!」

stage0023_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「There's no way this ends here!
　This is the biggest $$バトリング$$ in history!」

stage0023_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Damn you, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　How dare you... how dare you!!」

stage0023_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
Spectator
「Get moving already, you slowpoke!
　I've got money riding on you!!」

stage0023_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
Spectator
「Wh, what!?
　What's it trying to do!?」

stage0023_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ココナ$$
「This is bad!
　He's gonna ram the $$地上戦艦$$ into us!」

stage0023_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$バニラ$$
「He's lost all reason!
　That guy's really gone off the deep end!」

stage0023_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「There's no time for the crowd to evacuate!
　Focus all fire on him!」

stage0023_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$クラン$$
「It's no use!
　That giant's rampage can't be stopped!」

stage0023_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I'll kill you, I'll kill you!
　I'll kill you all!!」

stage0023_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Th, that's against the rules!
　If an aerial battleship butts in,
　$$レッドショルダー$$ Team automatically loses!」

stage0023_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$キャシー$$
「That person...!
　Do they not understand the situation!?」

stage0023_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we'll just have to match the regulation.」

stage0023_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ミーナ#182$$
「All ships, be advised.
　This ship is entering transformation.」

stage0023_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「I-it turned into a robot!」

stage0023_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ボビー$$
「How about that?
　No complaints now, right?」

stage0023_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let 'em have it, $$ボビー$$!」

stage0023_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「See that, coward.
　This is how $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ fights!」

stage0023_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アルト$$
「Nice work, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

stage0023_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Heh... looks like the captain's
　blood was boiling too.」

stage0023_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Damn it!
　This ship is finished!!」

stage0023_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$宗介$$
「So this time it's an AT.」

stage0023_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Kill you, kill you, kill you!
　Kill you, kill you, kill you!
　Kill you, kill you, kill you!」

stage0023_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Kill you, kill you, kill you!
　Kill you, kill you, kill you!
　Kill you, kill you, kill you!」

stage0023_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　$$フィアナ$$ has been evacuated!」

stage0023_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I'll kill you, $$レッドショルダー$$!」

stage0023_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$キリコ$$
（This is my last battle
　as a $$レッドショルダー$$...）

stage0023_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Damn you, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　Kill you, kill you, kill you!
　Kill you, kill you, kill you!」

stage0023_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn you, $$ニーバ$$!
　Some $$ＰＳ$$ you are, and you're losing!」

stage0023_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Remember this, $$キリコ$$!
　Next time, I'll crush you for sure!」

stage0023_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There's no need to pursue.
　Now that we've felled their core $$ＰＳ$$,
　their plan in $$ア・コバ$$ is all but dead.」

stage0023_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ will catch those who fled,
　and make them talk about who's behind it.」

stage0023_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$バニラ$$
「You did it, $$キリコ$$!
　$$レッドショルダー$$ Team!
　You guys are the best!」

stage0023_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Tough luck, $$チェロキー$$.
　The biggest battle in history goes to me.」

stage0023_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$チェロキー$$
「Nngh...!
　All the money I made matchmaking,
　it's all gone now!」

stage0023_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Mixed feelings over there,
　but the Black $$バトリング$$'s over for now.」

stage0023_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$マオ$$
「We got $$キリコ$$'s girlfriend back too,
　so I guess it's a happy ending.」

stage0023_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
Chirico
（24th Melkia Front Army Armored Corps,
　Special Task Squad X-1, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...）

stage0023_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$キリコ$$
（It's true, I was a $$レッドショルダー$$...
　but that's over now...）

stage0023_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$キリコ$$
（As long as $$フィアナ$$, who saved me from hell, is here...）

stage0023_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Untouchable, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$.
　I'll be taking this woman.」

stage0023_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$モニカ$$
「No good!
　We lost it to some kind of stealth!」

stage0023_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「N-no good!
　Can't go on any further!」

stage0023_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Lord $$ニーバ$$, I leave the rest to you!」

stage0023_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
（It's a hassle, so just go down with $$キリコ$$.）

stage0023_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Well, fine.
　I'll give you credit for setting this stage.」

stage0023_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Running is pointless, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　I'll crush you flat!」

stage0023_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$キリコ$$
（Wait for me, $$フィアナ$$...
　I'm coming, now...!）

stage0023_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Heheh... hehehehe!
　No mistake, you're a $$レッドショルダー$$...!
　And a prime one at that!」

stage0023_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「You were the best...!
　The best prey I've ever had!」

stage0023_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「So, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　I'm the one who'll kill you!!」

stage0023_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Some Perfect Soldier you are!
　I won't lose to a heartless killing machine!」

stage0023_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「A loser's howl, is it!
　Can a mere human really beat me!」

stage0023_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't underestimate my anger!
　You'll pay for what you've done!」

stage0023_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Not bad, you...!
　Quite good, for a mere human!」

stage0023_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am not a mere human.
　I am a trained soldier.」

stage0023_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$宗介$$
「A guinea pig drunk on borrowed power
　cannot defeat a true soldier.」

stage0023_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「You bastarrrrd!
　Do you want to die that badly!」

stage0023_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$宗介$$
「The moment you drown in such emotion,
　you stop being perfect!」

stage0023_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Not worth talking to!
　You're being toyed with by your machine!」

stage0023_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$n
「Save your speeches for after you beat me.」

stage0023_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
「If you can't even beat someone like me,
　then know there's no way in hell
　you can fight $$キリコ$$!」

stage0023_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「You!
　You've got nerve, after what you pulled!」

stage0023_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$n
「Don't make me laugh.
　By that logic of who did what to whom,
　you're the bastard for playing dirty.」

stage0023_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「$$キリコ$$ doesn't even need to bother...!
　I'll take down the worst of the bastards!」
